title: Holy priest at 15 percent mana in a fight: the Balance druid innervates the healer

rules.desc: Innervate on the low-mana healer: in a fight where the Holy priest hire sits at 15 percent mana, the Balance druid hire casts Innervate on it within 20 s of the fight starting
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/BalanceDruidStrategy.cpp:290-301 (the Balance buff strategy fires innervate in combat at ACTION_HIGH + 1); ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/DruidTriggers.h:503-531 (InnervateTrigger: a target under AiPlayerbot.InnervateManaThreshold, from boost targets or FindBestInnervateTarget); ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/DruidInnervateHelper.h:14 (FindBestInnervateTarget); ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAIConfig.cpp:741 (AiPlayerbot.InnervateManaThreshold default 25); TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649
rules.why_expect: 15 percent is under the 25 percent threshold and the priest is the only party member on mana (the warrior has none; the druid spends its own but innervates another), so FindBestInnervateTarget returns the priest and the combat row fires at ACTION_HIGH + 1. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649

rules.desc: Companion: the druid never innervates the warrior: no Innervate cast of the druid aims at the player in the fight
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/DruidTriggers.h:503-531 (InnervateTrigger.IsTargetValid: the target's mana percent must be under AiPlayerbot.InnervateManaThreshold); ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/DruidInnervateHelper.h:14 (FindBestInnervateTarget walks the group's mana users); ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAIConfig.cpp:741; TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649
rules.why_expect: a warrior has no mana pool, so GetManaPercent on the player cannot pass the 25 percent threshold and InnervateTrigger cannot select it

rules.desc: Precondition: the priest hire cast something at least 3 times in the window, so a fight where the healer never acted is not read as a missed Innervate
rules.source: precondition: any cast by the low-mana hire; the healer rows are ai/playerbot/strategy/priest/HolyPriestStrategy.cpp:29-72 (heals and shields on the player), TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649
rules.why_expect: 15 percent of a level 60 priest's pool is one or two heals; free rows and regen may add a third cast inside 60 s, so whether the floor is 3 is the open question (the same question PRI-LOWMANA-HEALS leaves open at level 40)
